description: Election Commission - Declare that H. M. Azsar was Selected as the member of the Reedigama P/S - Declare that Mr. R. M. J. Kumara was Selected as the member of the Galnewa P/S - Declare that Mrs. H. Indrani was Selected as the member of the Rajanganaya P/S.
categorisation: This gazette content contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific members of Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in their respective political parties. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, fitting the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including vacating of offices and changes in candidate status.
